meta.name: novel-to-game
meta.description: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prototype. NovelToGame 总入口。把任意语言的原始小说、拆文库或 oh-story 写作工程转成有原著依据、可在目标平台完整游玩的游戏，编排游戏化拆解、概念选择、游戏与视觉设计、目标运行环境构建和证据化质量验证。用于小说转游戏、把这本书做成游戏等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把小说改编成可在目标平台游玩的游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有小说想变成可玩的游戏
copy.tagline_en: Turn a novel into a playable game on your target platform.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel and want to make it a playable game.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把任意语言的小说改编成可在所选平台完整游玩的游戏：先做需求 intake 锁定产品简报，再依次完成游戏化拆解、概念选择、世界/视觉设计、构建和 QA，每阶段落盘文档并检查达标后才继续。
howto.when: 当你说要改编小说、故事或书为游戏，例如“小说转游戏”“把这本书做成游戏”时触发。

say.text: 把《三体》做成一个网页游戏
say.note: 会先锁定目标平台与画风，再进入拆解。

say.text: 用 director 模式改编这部小说
say.note: 会先给三个概念和推荐，等你选定后继续。

say.text: 继续上次的小说改编进度
say.note: 会读取进度文件，从最早未过门的阶段继续。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns any-language novels into a playable game on your chosen platform: intake locks a brief, then handles deconstruction, concept, world/visual design, build, and QA, writing files and checking gates between stages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a novel, story, or book into a game, e.g. novel-to-game or book-to-game requests.

say_en.text: Turn this novel into a web game.
say_en.note: It locks platform and art style first, then deconstructs.

say_en.text: Adapt this novel in director mode.
say_en.note: It presents three concepts and a recommendation, then waits for your choice.
It reads progress and continues from the earliest unpassed gate.
